claims.title: Global modulation, curved-phase Jensen families and explicit compatible moment certificates

status: Source claims plus separate internal advances; externally unreviewed.
interface: General C2 rank-one-convex flux identity in any matrix dimensions for affine convex-loop carrier and arbitrary real spatial amplitude; invariant planar quartic coercivity mu/12 and one-coordinate complex envelope mu/24. New sheared non-affine family needs half-turn symmetry and two curvature cancellations. Explicit8x8 moment completions and closed dual conic-hull characterization do not imply arbitrary-gradient inclusion.
limits: Construct or separate full nine-moment completions for genuinely connected compatible gradients outside certified profiles, with exact all-background optimization and certified acoustic rank-one convexity; obtain independent analytic and historical review.
